svg.title: omnitrix at work
svg.desc: Claude sits in the middle and plans. A selector turns to the best account for each task: Codex, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, Groq and a local Ollama model. Tasks travel out, results come back. When Kimi is rate limited, its task moves to GLM. A job log on the right follows along.
